verdict_reason: Expectations match the two-type roles map, but a replacement assertion names the retired BRANCH_ADDRESS role.

todos.issue: The replacement assertion keepRolesOfferedBy('ORIGIN_OR_CONSIGNOR', ['BRANCH_ADDRESS']) names the role this PR deletes from ROLES (address-types.js:12-18). A reader sees a role code that exists nowhere else in src and has to learn from git that it once did; the test's purpose (an unknown role is dropped) is not said by the value.
todos.fix: Must: the test names no retired role; if dropping a role no type lists is worth proving, its input says it is unknown. One way: use a value such as 'NOT_A_ROLE', or delete the assertion since the line above already proves a role outside the type is dropped.
